New code in the latest iOS WhatsApp beta suggests users may soon be able to customise their combination of emoji reactions, replacing the default options. Here are the details.

WhatsApp testing custom emoji reaction combinations

According to WABetaInfo, the latest TestFlight version of WhatsApp has added a setting called "Default reactions" that lets users change the emojis shown in the reaction menu.

When a user long-presses a message, they see the emoji reaction menu, which currently defaults to six emojis: 👍, ❤️, 😂, 😮, 😢, and 🙏. These six default reactions are followed by a horizontally scrollable row of frequently used or recently used emojis. Users can also tap the "+" key to quickly find other emojis.

However, according to WABetaInfo's findings, the new feature may be limited to WhatsApp Plus subscribers, allowing users to replace any of these six default reactions with emojis of their own choosing.

Here is what WABetaInfo has to say:

WABetaInfo noted that this feature is not even available to beta users yet. However, since similar code was previously discovered in the WhatsApp Android beta, it is believed the platform will soon begin rolling out this feature to beta users before officially making it available to everyone.
